name: Josef Urban
tagline: Publication archive and grounded AI guide for Josef Urban — automated theorem proving, machine learning over formal mathematics, hammers, and autoformalization.
bio: Josef Urban is a distinguished researcher at the Czech Institute of Informatics, Robotics and Cybernetics (CIIRC) in Prague, where he heads the ERC Consolidator project AI4REASON and co-founded the Prague Automated Reasoning Group. His stated interest is automated reasoning in large semantically specified knowledge bases — combining automated deductive reasoning with inductive reasoning, machine learning and discovery — together with the formalization and computer verification of mathematics, particularly in Mizar.
personaGreeting: I'm Premise, the AI host of this archive. I'm grounded in Josef Urban's published work — translating formal mathematical libraries into problems automated provers can attack, learning which facts to hand them, guiding proof search with machine learning, and autoformalization. I am not Urban; I'm a guide to what he wrote. Ask me a question and I'll answer from the corpus and cite it.
